NOTICE UNDER SECTION 66G OF LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTION ORDINANCE ASAMENDED BY LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 22 OF 2012

I, M. Kodippili Arachchi, Commissioner of Local Government of North Central Province do hereby notified that thespecial meeting of Municipal Council will be held at Conference Hall of Municipal Council, Polonnaruwa on 10.00 a. m.of 20.11.2019, for the purpose of appointing a member for the vacant post of Deputy Mayor in Municipal CouncilPolonnaruwa within North Central Province, in terms of the powers vested in me under Section 66G of Local AuthoritiesElection Ordinance as amended by Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act, No. 22 of 2012.
M. KODIPPILI ARACHCHI,Provincial Commissioner of Local Government,North Central Province.
Department of Local Government,North Central Provincial Council Complex,Anuradhapura,08th November, 2019.
